notes: The leaf is only the left element of a door+sidelight+transom set; leaf bounds exclude the sidelight. The geometric leaf midpoint falls on glass, so colour was taken on paint at the same height (175,877). The leaf carries two handles: an operating black lever-rose at 0.48 height and a separate decorative horizontal pull bar lower down, recorded in extras. Timber casing is mahogany (#A0675B) against a taupe leaf, so same_colour_as_leaf is false.
